author: Zubielo
quote:
It’s a good looking game. But has no soul, horrible writing, and is completely «safe edgy». It’s literally the opposite of GTA V in every way. GTA V was a male crime fantasy game, where you become kingpins of the city. Climbing your way to the top, and get into all kinds of situations and people on the way.

GTA can simply never be about «romance», or atleast you shouldn’t be forced into a relationship. GTA is about player freedom, this is not freedom. And you just can’t have a leading female role in a GTA game.

You can have Lucia there like now, being an annoying **** with attitude who literally hides your kid from you. And you should have the option to kill her, cheat on her or be toxic towards her after what she has done. 

That would be a GTA game.
This is not GTA, this is what feminists women think GTA. **** pathetic.

And also, the **** frames man. I don’t have the ps5 pro, and it’s so **** hard at times. 
If the game was 40 dollars, then it would be a 5/10.
But with the biggest price tag, i expect a good product. Don’t release it for ps5 if it can’t **** get 30 fps when literally doing what the game is meant to do
